# Reverse Engineering Toolkit — a switchable DSH skill plugin

A DeepSeek Harness **bundle** that registers one model-invocable skill,
`reverse-engineering`, in th

e profile-global skill layer. Disable the plugin row
(or the whole bundle) in Plugin Manager and the

skill disappears from the session
catalog; enable it again and it comes back.

Repository: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill>
Index: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-plug

ins>
Companion plugin: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-install-profiler> (installation
profiling, dyn
amic probing, and the handoff brief that feeds this skill).

Inspired by the viral "REA — Reverse Engineer Anything" project
(<https://github.com/morluto/rea>),

which popularized agent-driven reverse
engineering after adding Android/APK analysis in October 2026

. This plugin is an
independent implementation: it ships instructions plus a local toolchain probe,
not REA's engine or MCP server.
## What it does

- Adds a `skill` catalog entry that the agent loads on demand, then follows to
classify an artifact,

probe installed decompilers, work an authorized target,
and report evidence-backed findings.
- Bund

les `scripts/probe-tools.ps1` (32 tools across Android/Java/.NET/native/
support, PATH + common inst

all dirs + Android SDK, ~1.5 s, read-only).
- Enforces a blocking authorization gate and an explicit

refusal list before any
tool call, and degrades honestly when a decompiler is missing.

Then confirm the row is active with `plugin_manager list_plugins` (look for
`reverse-skill`) or appr

oval-free `cordis_inspect_query` on the `Config`
provider filtered by `@local/dsh-reverse-skill`.
## On / off

- `plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=reverse-skill enabled=false` — unregisters
the skill; the

next turn receives a replacement catalog without it.
- `enabled=true` — re-registers it (the SKILL.

md body is re-read on activation,
so content edits take effect after a toggle, without restarting DS

H).
- `action=remove_bundle target=@local/dsh-reverse-skill` — uninstalls completely.

## Safety

The skill refuses DRM/licence/anti-cheat bypass, credential theft, unauthorized
targets, live-servic

e interaction, and redistribution of decompiled material. It
never executes a target on the host; dy

namic analysis is limited to a disposable
device/VM the user authorizes. Decompiling a client never

reveals server-side
logic — the skill states that limit instead of overselling.
